assumptions.statement: The Jingzhang AI innovation district block-level regulatory plan was publicly reported approved in August 2026, but formal plan drawings, parcel controls, official redlines, ownership, utilities, building survey, engineering constraints, investment and approval conditions are not contained in this package.
assumptions.impact: The approved one-belt/one-axis, two-centres/multiple-nodes structure is treated as the statutory background. One axis, three cores and two wings is an operating overlay only; all parcel, works and cost decisions await official files and professional review.

assumptions.statement: The repository provisional constraint is used consistently for topology, EPSG:4548 recalculation and visual packaging.
assumptions.impact: Geometry is reproducible but unsuitable for official area scoring, statutory control or parcel-level decisions.

assumptions.statement: NIS-Lite and EHS-Lite are monitoring frameworks, not current Haidian scores.
assumptions.impact: Baseline values require public or cleared enterprise, project, service and community data with privacy review.

assumptions.statement: Scenario operators, phasing, landmarks and service mechanisms are reference schemes.
assumptions.impact: They do not constitute government, investment, construction or event commitments.

assumptions.statement: Alibaba Beijing headquarters is used only as an external anchor-institution mechanism benchmark.
assumptions.impact: No site shift, corporate participation, logo use, compute opening, investment or implementation commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: Five architectural and district-scale view groups are AI-generated concept images without exact site or engineering input.
assumptions.impact: They communicate experience only and are never used for boundaries, areas, controls, demolition, feasibility or cost claims.

assumptions.statement: The operating account uses unit formulas and sensitivity variables without a site-wide investment total.
assumptions.impact: Rent, cost, return and public funding require official assets, rights, market appraisal and authorized decisions.

assumptions.statement: Public sources report phase-2 works complete, the park open and the block-level plan approved in 2026.
assumptions.impact: The proposal works on interfaces of an operating park rather than a blank site; these sources do not establish precise assets, routes, field conflicts or performance.

assumptions.statement: Three flagship prototypes package six existing projects into twelve-week reversible operating contracts.
assumptions.impact: Twelve weeks is a taskbook sequence, not an approved construction schedule; no operator, procurement, engineering or corporate commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: Expansion requires a public-return package and an independent-survival review after real operation.
assumptions.impact: No current enterprise survival or public-return result is claimed; all result fields remain null before field evidence and human sign-off.
